10+Years of Craft
Our Story

Embracing the craft, elevating every chair.

The Gravity opened in 2016 as a two-chair neighbourhood salon. Clients kept asking to learn what we did — so we built a classroom above the salon floor. Today, 1,000+ students and thousands of happy clients later, the salon and academy still share one team and one standard: craft before trend, honesty at the chair.

Bittu Sharma, founder and principal educator, has spent years behind the chair before ever stepping in front of a classroom. Known for his hands-on teaching and refusal to cut corners, his mission is simple — train stylists who are ready for a real salon floor from day one.

His philosophy is rooted in one guiding principle:
Skill first, ego later.

Every student trains on a live salon floor, working with real clients from day one — because a certificate means nothing until it holds up in front of a paying client. It's the same standard the salon side runs on: no rushed cuts, no shortcuts, just honest craft, chair after chair, class after class.

"We built Gravity on a simple belief — the person in the chair and the person behind it both deserve our absolute best."

Bittu Sharma — Founder & Principal Educator
